_comment: Disks used only to detect resistance mechanisms (no S/I/R breakpoints): appended to the antibiotic catalogue
after the seed standards (see app/main.py SEED_DISKS_AFTER). Never remove or reorder entries: the in-browser
catalogue (frontend/src/browser/catalog.json) keeps their ids. 'pairs_with' is the plain disk the zone of the
combination disk is compared with (frontend/src/phenotypes.ts COMBINATIONS lists the same pairs).
Sources: EUCAST guidelines for detection of resistance mechanisms and specific resistances of clinical and/or
epidemiological importance v2.01 (July 2017), section 2.4.2 Table 2 (meropenem 10 ug disk/tablet with inhibitors),
section 3.4.2 Tables 2-3 (cephalosporin +/- clavulanic acid 10 ug), and EUCAST technical guidance on the
combination disk test for confirmation of ESBL (12 February 2019): cefotaxime 5 ug and ceftazidime 10 ug +/-
clavulanic acid 10 ug. Inhibitor amounts of the meropenem combinations depend on the manufacturer.
Codes: catalogue labels (MRPxx in the style of Rosco tablet codes, not verified; CTXCV/CAZCV/FEPCV for the CDT disks), read by the OCR like any
catalogue code. Other manufacturers' codes can be added to seed/disk_codes.json (none added: not verified).
